name: Can I remove smoke smell from walls myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove smoke smell from walls myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY methods like cleaning surfaces with household detergents, painting, or using air fresheners can temporarily mask or lightly reduce smoke odors, they rarely eliminate the smell entirely, especially if the smoke exposure was significant. Smoke particles are often deeply embedded in porous materials. Professional restoration uses specialized equipment and cleaning agents to neutralize and extract these odors, preventing their return. Attempting extensive DIY odor removal without proper tools can sometimes worsen the issue or be ineffective.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY methods can mask light smoke odors, but rarely eliminate deep-seated smells in walls. Professional restoration is usually required for complete removal.
